capacity_adjusted_profile_assessment.permitted: A new separately identified, predeclared operating-point experiment may reduce offered rates while keeping original adverse evidence visible.

sections: 6: initial reference capacities frozen per experiment

required_conditions: Preserve original invalid/adverse rows and their exact identities; do not relabel their outcomes or erase unfavorable cells.

Freeze the new rates, seed/dataset, request counts, warmup, client concurrency, controller/artifacts and rationale before execution. Apply identical operating points and functional/durability/resource semantics across comparable routes.

Retain low/high concurrency, small/large payload, streaming, overload and other required workload coverage. Do not solve invalid generator cells by ignoring lag/capacity or broadening correctness thresholds.
Use fresh complete independent calibration and confirmation cohorts with reviewed measured noise bands. Do not mix historical/new rows or infer that the old offered rate passed.
Any failed functional oracle still invalidates that cell. A new operating point establishes only scoped cost/capacity observations, not a product correctness fix or universal performance superiority.
B22 actual30-minute,24-hour and72-hour durations and independent correctness remain final acceptance dependencies. B24 start order and clean release gates remain unchanged.
